name: @rhombus-std/examples.lib.with-transformer
description: Example dependency library authored in the tokenless di dialect and built via the Go/ttsc engine. In-repo consumers resolve its source and lower it at load time; the build is what a published consumer would receive.
//dependencies: di.core ONLY — never @rhombus-std/di. A library contributes registrations and takes its dependencies as parameters; the resolution engine belongs to the entrypoint packages that build a container. di.extras is a devDependency because it is the AUTHORING surface (declare-module sugar + inline bodies), not a runtime dependency, and it peers on di.core rather than on the engine; primitives.extras is likewise authoring-only — but its typefor<T>() folds to a Type EXPRESSION, so the lowered output imports @rhombus-std/primitives at run time and that one is a real dependency, kept external in the bundle so the Type intern table stays shared.
